title: Cognous V1 validation failure register
description: Entries keep their historical, heterogeneous fields (additional properties allowed). Only the fields below are constrained. closure_evidence (C12) is optional and says how a closure was established, not whether the entry is closed: it never changes a status or verdict.

label.description: machine-asserted: a harness assertion closed it. independently-checked: a party other than the harness author re-checked it. human-validated: a named person validated it.

owner.description: Named owner of the closure claim. The literal 'unassigned' is allowed only with machine-asserted (conservative back-fill).
